svg.title: The kitchen car, the third morning, quarter past five
svg.desc: A narrow galley kitchen on a moving train before dawn, with a stove, two sinks, a rubber mat on a worn floor, a handrail, and a cupboard with a green cross and a padlock.

g.text: The kitchen car, the third morning, quarter past five
Fourteen things to find. The floor under the mat is worn in the shape of two feet.
the stove and the two sinks
the mat, and the floor under it
the cupboard with the green cross
the door to the dining car
the first coffee of the day
Ruth - twenty-three years in this spot
the handrail, and one hand always on it
the cupboard with the green cross, padlocked
Nadia - as far into the galley as anybody gets
the door to the dining car
